title: [GMCP 203.007.03] Integration: Transport adapter SPI and embedded/in-process operation
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-007-03. Wire the capability through every applicable server, client, host, gateway, SDK, CLI, configuration, callback, supervisor, persistence, and migration surface. Prove that direct, daemon, and gateway entry points share the same implementation and policy boundaries. Vector outcome: A stable transport SPI admits in-process, Unix-domain socket, named-pipe, WebSocket or future transports without changing protocol semantics. A common conformance harness proves ordering, cancellation, limits, identity propagation, observability, shutdown, and error equivalence across adapters, while experimental transports are capability-negotiated and never silently presented as standard MCP. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
